description: Ilias Kaltsas at Ricardo publishes model outputs for Man0EUvRE Case Study 7, titled Greece as a renewable energy hub. The native description explicitly identifies outputs from PRIMES model runs. Zenodo lists one XLSX results workbook and offers free open access under CC BY 4.0. This record represents the deposited case-specific results, not the PRIMES software or a complete set of model inputs. Coverage is Greece; the short description does not give scenario names, years, variables, units, temporal resolution or subnational regions. The collection is related to the wider European Energy Vision scenario programme, but the exact scenario version used is unspecified. A limitation is that the workbook was not opened, so its internal dimensions and suitability for reproducing the reported planning study remain unverified. No additional results are inferred from the case title.
